column3: The EVI is calculated as 1/2 of the Economic vulnerability index and 1/2 of the Environmental vulnerability index.

The Economic vulnerability index is calculated as 1/4 of the Share of agriculture, forestry and fisheries, 1/4 of the Remoteness and landlockedness, 1/4 of the Export concentration and 1/4 of the Export instability.
